verdict.rationale: HashiCorp documents an official Terraform MCP server that gives AI models real-time access to registry provider docs, modules, and policies. It also supports HCP Terraform/Enterprise workspace operations (create/update/delete workspaces, variables, tags, run management), and a probe confirms the official MCP server page. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents connecting to it, documented setup/transport and authentication details for connecting an agent.
